name: Google Sheet → Airtable Leads Sync
description: Daily sync that reads new leads from a Google Sheet, checks for duplicates in Airtable by company name, and adds only genuinely new leads with an auto-assigned Temperature based on city.

nodes.name: Check If Sheet Has Data
nodes.notes: Filters out empty rows and rows with no Business Name; stops the run cleanly if the sheet has nothing new

nodes.name: Check If Lead Exists in Airtable
nodes.notes: Searches the CRM base by company name (FIND formula) to detect existing leads

nodes.name: Is New Lead?
nodes.notes: True when no matching Airtable record id was returned

nodes.name: Map Fields & Set Temperature
nodes.notes: Maps sheet columns to CRM fields; sets Temperature to Hot for Guwahati-based leads, Warm otherwise

nodes.name: Skip Duplicate Lead
nodes.notes: No-op branch for leads that already exist in Airtable

main.node: Check If Lead Exists in Airtable

meta.companion_workflow: Paired with a Telegram approval bridge (native inline buttons) that lets Prasanna approve or reject the AI-drafted outreach email for each new lead with a single tap — no separate n8n link popup.
